name: Podium multifamily (5-over-1/2)
summary: Four to five floors of Type III/V wood framing over a one- or two-level concrete podium holding parking, lobby, amenity and often retail. The concrete podium, elevators, Type III fire-retardant framing and urban sites put it ~1.5x garden cost per unit. Evidence: RLB city multifamily ranges, RSMeans 4-7 story, Florida HFA mid-rise factors, developer/contractor ranges and older architect ratios; no public elemental breakdown was found, so the CSI split is derived.

typicalSize.method: Typical urban/infill 5-over-1 or 5-over-2 block; 150-300 units common (judgment; consistent with RSMeans 4-7 story building range of 34,000-115,000 SF at the low end and larger full-block projects at the high end).

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: Gross residential + lobby/amenity SF per unit, excluding podium parking area. Census median new rental unit 1,000 net SF (e16, all types); urban podium units average ~800-900 net SF at ~80% efficiency plus ground-floor lobby/amenity.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: LandSouth and Apers: 80-120+ units/acre; widened to 70-150 for 5-over-2 and small-unit urban projects.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Apers: 1.0-1.5 spaces/unit structured for mid-rise; urban infill with reduced minimums often ~0.7-1.0.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Per-unit = perSF x sfPerPrimaryUnit: mid $290 x 1,050 = ~$305k; low $235 x 950 = ~$225k; high $385 x 1,200 = ~$460k. Cross-checks: Florida mid-rise LIHTC hard-cost factors $284-339k/unit (e13, e14 - caps for affordable deals); Terrapin 4-over-1 $310-485k and 5-over-1 $340-525k/unit (e3, contractor marketing, high-cost bias).

perSF.method: 2026 evidence: LandSouth/Apers $235-350 (e1, e2; midpoint ~$292); RLB multifamily 18-city median $225-410 (e5) with podium-heavy metros LA $275-450, Seattle $295-505, Denver $225-415 (e6-e8); RSMeans 4-7 story $210-475 (e4). Mid $290 ~= LandSouth/Apers midpoint and ~1.2x wrap ($240) / ~1.57x garden ($185). Ratio checks: LA podium premium +$50-75/SF over Type V (e12); MFE 2016 podium/wrap ~1.37x (e9); EVstudio 2018 urban podium vs suburban walk-up ~1.2x (e10); Brookings high-rise ~+$75/SF over six-story podium (e11). High = Terrapin 4-over-1 upper ($385) and West Coast RLB ranges.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. general conditions and OH&P, the concrete podium with its parking (~1.0 space/unit at grade/podium level), elevators, amenity deck and on-site work; perSF is per gross residential + lobby/amenity SF (podium parking area excluded from SF, cost included). Excludes land, soft costs, FF&E, off-sites, impact/tap fees, financing and below-grade parking (optional line item).

qualityTiers.method: Terrapin 5-over-1 range $340-525k (high/low ~1.5, e3) and EVstudio amenity premium ~+6% (e10); same tier steps as garden/wrap with luxury reflecting high-amenity urban product.

systemSplit.method: Derived from the garden split (RAND Table 3.4 mapping, see garden-multifamily.json) adjusted for a 1-2 level concrete podium and 4-5 wood floors: concrete 03 raised to 14% (podium deck, columns, ramps), framing 06 lowered to 14% (fewer wood floors per unit of area, Type III FRT framing), elevators 14 at 2%, sprinklers 21 at 2% (incl. standpipes/fire pump share), HVAC 23 5% (corridor/garage ventilation), exterior 07/08 up (taller facade, storefront), site divisions 31-33 cut to 5.5% (urban lot). Verify against a podium GMP.

lineItems.name: Parking inside the concrete podium (grade / podium level)

cost.method: Derived: WGI 2024 free-standing structure median $29,900/space (e15) is the floor; podium parking carries transfer-slab, fire-rating and ventilation premiums, so ~1.0-1.8x that (2026).

lineItems.name: Below-grade parking level (excavation, shoring, waterproofing)

cost.method: Derived: below-grade spaces typically ~2-3x above-grade structure cost (WGI above-grade median $29,900, e15) once excavation, shoring and waterproofing are included (2026 judgment).

lineItems.notes: Optional - add when parking ratio cannot be met within the podium.

cost.method: Derived: installed 6-7 stop traction elevator ~ $150-275k each (2026).

lineItems.name: Podium amenity deck (pool, waterproofing, landscape over structure)

cost.method: Derived 2026 judgment: on-structure pool, pavers, planters and waterproofing for a ~200-unit project.

lineItems.name: Ground-floor retail shell (cold dark shell)

cost.method: Derived: retail shell within the concrete podium ~ $175-300/SF (2026), excluding tenant improvements.

lineItems.notes: Optional; mixed-use podiums often required by zoning.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Derived: lobby, clubroom, fitness, co-working, roof/podium deck furniture ~ $350-800k for ~220 units (2026).

pctOfHard.method: RAND market-rate soft/hard 0.19 (TX/CO) to 0.33 (CA, where podium is the dominant type) incl. financing (e17); Brookings 20-30% of total cost (e18). Mid 0.25 reflects heavier structural/MEP design, entitlement and urban permitting than garden; excludes construction interest. | Second pass (2026-10-24, main session): Reduced 5 points: RAND-based, includes developer costs and fees. The engine adds impact & tap fees, the developer fee and construction financing as their own lines (docs/BUDGET_ENGINE.md §5), so this bucket must exclude them.

softCosts.notes: Urban impact fees and utility capacity charges can be large (RAND: CA ~$29k/unit) - model separately.

hard.method: Derived industry norm for urban podium projects (below-grade/utility risk).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Hard low $225k x 1.12 ~= $250k; hard high $460k x 1.42 ~= $650k.
